# s219 — Resolve whole dependency titles before splitting outline commas

An outline dependency can name an item whose title contains commas without breaking existing comma-separated dependency lists.

**Findings:** agents feedback 2026-10-05 U10; docs/feedback/agents-2026-10-05.md · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**2026-10-06** — Ready for review: outline.parse keeps each depends: line raw; ops._resolve_outline_depends resolves once in outline_report (whole known title first, else comma split), and apply_outline saves those same edges, so import, dry-run and the wizard agree. Promote still refuses any depends line. Replayed onto main at 2ca7282. Full suite 1357 OK (1 skipped), slicer check ok, git diff --check clean.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:** changing tree splitting, adding a YAML/CSV dependency, introducing quoted-list syntax, or resolving unknown titles by guessing.

## Why

outline._assign currently splits depends immediately, before the known title set is available. U10's repeated-line workaround alone does not stop splitting a comma inside one value. The owner chose whole-title-first resolution with comma-list fallback.

## Files

Pure outline parser/spec, shared outline validation/apply planning in ops, import and wizard consumers of that planner, the promote refusal of item-level keys, outline/import/promote tests, skeleton/help and import documentation.

## Failing tests

- A full depends value matching a comma-containing title in the same outline or existing index becomes one edge in dry-run and apply.
- A value without a whole-title match retains today's comma-list behavior; repeated lines combine dependencies in declared order.
- If both a whole title and its comma pieces exist, the whole-title match wins. Existing full-title/display-title lookup semantics remain supported.
- Unknown whole/piece references collect validation errors and refuse the whole file. Whitespace and empty-piece behavior retain existing validation semantics.
- Import and the wizard share one resolver in apply_outline. Forward references work, and preview edge counts agree with saved edges.
- A promote source that sets depends, including a not-yet-split depends line, is refused with field_in_promote_source and writes nothing. Promote does not resolve titles or write depends_on.

## Implement

Retain each raw depends value until the known title set exists, instead of irreversibly splitting it in the pure parser. Resolve once in apply_outline, which import and the wizard both call, after constructing that set: exact whole-value match first, otherwise the existing comma splitter. Reuse the resolved dependencies for validation, edge counts, ID mapping and apply. Dry-run and save must not choose different interpretations.

Promote does not call that planner. It still refuses every item-level key and writes nothing. Point field_in_promote_source at the raw depends value, not only at an already-split spec.depends list, so moving the split out of outline._assign cannot skip the refusal. A promote source never writes depends_on.

Keep parsing text-in/dataclasses-out with no project I/O. Preserve existing title lookup aliases, unknown-reference collection, cycle handling and all-or-nothing behavior. Document explicit precedence and repeated-key examples for both comma-containing titles and multiple dependencies. Update skeleton guidance and parser tests to assert raw lines plus resolved import and wizard behavior, and the promote refusal for a depends line.
